correctness.rationale: The digit Fourier products are absolutely convergent in deviations from one at every integer frequency. A primitive 3^s zero is characterized exactly by three-equal-coset coefficient counts; when s>=2, the residue-class multiplicities of the six-digit mask are permutations of (3,2,1) or (2,2,2), violating the necessary divisibility by three. The three-digit mask likewise has no primitive higher-order zeros. At order three, both masks vanish precisely at residue pairs (1,2),(2,1). The unique 3-adic valuation layer then proves complete equality; a disjoint two-class-per-layer count gives density 1/4, and disjoint triangular IFS cells give dimensions 1 and log_3 6. Exact finite standalone checks across 59048 primitive pairs and complete residues to level five passed, but infinite statements are proved analytically.
